pr.title: docs(cockpit): regenerate current head inventory
pr.body:
## Summary
- regenerate Cockpit command/surface inventory evidence against current HEAD using accepted artifacts and current runtime source inspection
- produce deterministic inventory, drift, current-head status, next-packet, hash, and proof artifacts
- preserve UNKNOWN/drift, T4 refusal, TX/TU non-execution, and Claude Design blockers

## Strict scope
- artifact-only plus focused artifact tests
- no final screens
- no Claude Design upload
- no runtime action execution
- no T4 remote mutation
- no live service adapters
- no canonical writes
- no runtime reclassification

## Governance state
safe_for_claude_design: NO
READY_FOR_CLAUDE_DESIGN: not approved

## Validation
See closeout proof for command outputs and exit codes.

## Residual risks and downstream packets
- aggregate records are used where accepted artifacts do not expose per-row evidence
- remote-mutation policy remains absent, so T4 stays refused
- additional UNKNOWN resolution remains packet-owned outside runtime
- PR chain may need merge/stack consolidation before further design work

steps.task: Inspect repo authority, accepted Cockpit package/runtime/settings/unknown-drift artifacts, current Cockpit runtime sources, tests, and existing inventory tooling before implementation.
validation: Dedicated worktree is verified from origin/codex/cockpit-unknown-drift-001 at b6b89fae076a669952ef1178d7d7d17a3e01eb7b.
Accepted package/runtime/settings/unknown-drift proof artifacts parse as JSON.
Missing root authority files and schema files are recorded as UNKNOWN rather than inferred.

steps.task: Create deterministic aggregate inventory artifacts from accepted counts and current runtime source evidence without mutating accepted upstream artifacts.
validation: Inventory preserves five top-level modes, four global surfaces, Settings/Admin summary, Unknown/Drift summary, T4 blocked state, and TX/TU non-execution.
Aggregate records are used wherever per-row evidence is unavailable.

steps.task: Create drift, current-head status, next-packet decision, hash, and proof artifacts.
validation: Drift report classifies stale/uncomparable inputs without pretending row-level precision.
NEXT_PACKET_DECISION_MATRIX.md does not recommend Claude Design final screens while blockers remain.

steps.task: Add focused artifact tests for inventory regeneration invariants and boundary preservation.
validation: Boundary greps pass without forbidden positive governance claims or forbidden runtime call tokens.

validation: PR URL or exact blocker is recorded in proof and final closeout.
